title: Schema evolution without breaking the corpus
plainLanguage: The skeleton will probably gain more perspective and assembly information, but old work should remain understandable and usable.
purpose: Let the Corpus Pane grow for years without turning each redesign into a reset.

rules.statement: Version schemas and keep explicit adapters/migrations; never silently reinterpret an old field.
Prefer namespaced extensions for new perspective/assembly metadata before changing core joint identity.
Any skeleton-version change should include a migration report showing which references remain eligible, stale, or incompatible.

implementation.currentSupport: Corpus Pane already retains unknown extension fields and version identities.
implementation.futureWork: Use this package as the first structured namespace for perspective and poser knowledge.
